analysis_method: NumPy/SciPy deterministic signal measurements. No audio-input listening was available.
audience_and_venue_limit: Raw concert mix includes cheers, applause and audience singing. These cannot establish original vocals, instruments, composition climax or studio reverb. Automatic novelty/energy/key changes are unconfirmed musical-structure candidates.

edited_input.alignment: Piecewise media-event mapping, with initial playback mapping uncertainty <0.67 s. Upload PCM16 file was analyzed.

tempo.autocorrelation_resolution_note: Onset envelope hop is 256/22050 seconds; reported interpolated-grid BPM precision exceeds physical lag resolution. Interpret with Fourier and local windows.
tempo.caveat: Periodicity peaks may represent half/double beats or subdivisions; perceived meter requires listening.

tonality.caveat: Spectral-peak chroma and key/chord template correlations are hypotheses, not transcription. Live reverb, melody, bass and overtones can change rankings. Chord inversion is not estimated.

dynamics.note: dBFS is relative to the recorded digital scale; browser volume affects absolute values. Not LUFS or original master loudness.

acoustic_change_candidates.method: Adjacent 8-second standardized feature means; peak distance >=16 seconds. Not manually confirmed verse/chorus labels.

adjacent_8_second_measurements.classification: Unconfirmed acoustic change; crowd and venue can produce these changes.

acoustic_change_candidates.harmonic_continuity_note: Time-median/frequency-median spectral mask energy share is a sustained horizontal-pattern proxy, not proof of an instrument, chord, or crowd-free sustain.
acoustic_change_candidates.onset_density_definition: Positive spectral-flux peaks >0.5 of global 95th-percentile normalization, at least 70 ms apart.
